title: make_folding_atlas
description: Script to iteratively create a cortical folding atlas.

output_base.description: Output base; the subject will be named based on this.
output_base.title: Output base

xhemi.description: Do xhemi (sets hemilist to lh only, use --lhrh after if both are wanted).
xhemi.title: Xhemi flag

init_surf_reg.description: Registration used to make template on first iteration (default sphere.reg).
init_surf_reg.title: Initial surface registration

init_subject.description: Create first atlas from subject instead of all subjects.
init_subject.title: Initial subject

lhrh.description: Process both left and right hemispheres (default).
lhrh.title: Both hemispheres flag

no_vol_on_last.description: Do not run make_average_volume on the last iteration.
no_vol_on_last.title: No volume on last iteration flag

init.description: Use previous iteration registration to initialize mris_register/surfreg.
init.title: Initialize from previous registration flag

short_sleep.description: Sleep for a shorter time before polling.
short_sleep.title: Short sleep flag

no_template_only.description: Make average surface files even with a single hemi or --no-vol.
no_template_only.title: No template only flag

slurm_account.description: SLURM account or set FS_BATCH_ACCOUNT environment variable.
slurm_account.title: SLURM account
